nodes.label: Reliable Source
nodes.description: The testimony or evidence comes from a historically reliable source.

nodes.label: Cognitive Bias
nodes.description: The agent has a relevant cognitive bias (confirmation bias, anchoring, etc.).

nodes.label: Strong Evidence
nodes.description: The available evidence is strong and well-corroborated.

nodes.label: Justified Belief
nodes.description: The agent has a belief that is epistemically justified.

nodes.label: True Proposition
nodes.description: The believed proposition actually corresponds to reality.

nodes.label: Knowledge
nodes.description: The agent has knowledge (justified true belief, assuming no Gettier cases).

nodes.label: Testimony Shared
nodes.description: The agent shares their knowledge via testimony to others.

nodes.label: Social Knowledge
nodes.description: The knowledge propagates into the social/collective epistemic sphere.
